label: TA

notes.grounding: Option loop, globals, show_help, trailing exit-code comment, final exit 0, Overall Completion label and integer rounding all match the script. Two loose claims: the script does not always exit 0, and the printed percentage in output_text is a local, so it cannot be read after the output call.
notes.requirements: Testable REQs cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at N, unchanged output, and missing, non-integer and out-of-range values, plus --file mode. Behaviour for --file on a missing file (no percentage) and for --json mode is not stated.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause with a command and expected output, and P is derived from the run. Gaps: with one placeholder in many lines P rounds to 100, so P+1 = 101 is a usage error, not exit 3; abc and -1 are never checked; T009 diffs stdout only; T011 assumes a placeholder-free spec.md in a fixture defined to have a placeholder; the file-mode exit-3 case is never run.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1, out-of-scope list is sensible, no filler and no unfilled tokens.
notes.consistency: Ids, paths, exit codes 0/1/3 and the 0-100 range agree across the three docs. Small mismatches: SC-002 promises stdout and stderr identical but T009 checks stdout only; REQ-005 has a file-mode exit-3 check that no task runs.
notes.clarity: A developer can implement it directly. Unclear: where the file-mode percentage comes from after output_text returns, and what happens with --file on a missing file.

defects: spec.md:33: says the script 'always exits 0'; it exits 1 on a missing folder, missing --file/folder argument, missing bc or unexpected argument (calculate-completeness.sh:254-257, 555-572)

plan.md:28: says the check 'reads the percentage the output functions already computed'; in output_text the percentage is a local (calculate-completeness.sh:376-387), so in --file mode it must be re-sourced from the stats file, which the plan does not state
plan.md:57: 'Output functions ... are the source of the number to compare' is misleading for the same reason; only OVERALL_PERCENTAGE is global

tasks.md:32-33: fixture only needs 'at least one unfilled placeholder'; with few placeholders over many lines the rounded P is 100 (printf %.0f, script line 293), so T006/T010 run --min-percent 101, which REQ-004 makes exit 1, not 3
tasks.md:54: T005 verifies only 101; the 'abc', '-1' and missing-folder ordering cases of REQ-004 are never verified (plan.md:87-88 also omits abc and -1)
tasks.md:53: T004 verify is split into two statements and does not suppress or capture stderr separately, so 'prints ERROR: on stderr' is not actually asserted
tasks.md:65: T009 diffs stdout only, while spec.md:92 (SC-002) promises stdout and stderr byte-identical; --json output is not compared at all
tasks.md:67: T011 needs $F/spec.md to have no placeholders, but tasks.md:32 defines $F as a folder with an unfilled placeholder and does not say which file holds it

spec.md:81: REQ-005 requires --file mode with --min-percent $((P+1)) to exit 3, but no task verifies it, and the $P sed in tasks.md:33 matches only 'Overall Completion', not the file-mode 'Completion:' line
spec.md:81: --file on a nonexistent file reports NOT FOUND with no percentage (script lines 321-335); the threshold behaviour for that case is unspecified
